Word — Meaning — En français A recipe — It tells you how to cook a dish. — une recette Ingredients — The things you need to cook a dish. — les ingrédients A pot — You cook the soup in it. — une marmite To wash — To clean with water. — laver To cut — To make small pieces with a knife. — couper To boil — To cook in very hot water. — faire bouillir To add — To put one more thing in the pot. — ajouter To stir — To mix with a spoon. — remuer To taste — To eat a little to see if it is good. — goûter

notions.titre: 2. The ingredients of the tchonron soup
notions.texte: Word — En français bean leaves — les feuilles de haricot groundnut powder — la poudre d'arachide dried fish — le poisson séché chilli — le piment
C'est une sauce du nord de la Côte d'Ivoire, chez les Sénoufo. On la prépare avec des feuilles de haricot et de l'arachide.

notions.titre: Expressing obligation using must and have to
notions.texte: Pour dire qu'une chose est obligatoire (il faut la faire), utilise must ou have to.

Subject + must + verb Must ne change jamais : pas de -s, même avec he, she, it. Subject — Example I / You / We / They + must + verb — You must wash your hands before cooking. He / She / It + must + verb — She must cut the onions.
Mettre to après must : You must to wash → You must wash. Oublier has : She have to cook → She has to cook.
Must et have to veulent dire « devoir ». Après must, le verbe vient tout de suite. Have to, lui, garde toujours son to.

Dis chaque phrase en anglais. Le site t'écoute et te montre les mots bien dits. It tells you how to cook a dish. The things you need to cook a dish. You cook the soup in it. To make small pieces with a knife. To eat a little to see if it is good. She must cut the onions. My mother has to boil the water.
Cherche d'abord seule, à voix haute si tu peux. Ensuite, ouvre la correction.

notions.titre: Exercise 1 — Have to or has to?
notions.texte: Complète avec have to ou has to. I … cut the onions. My sister … wash the leaves. We … buy salt at the market. Aya … stir the soup. They … help their mother.

Remets les mots dans l'ordre pour faire une phrase. must / You / your hands / wash the water / boil / She / must taste / We / the soup / must You must wash your hands. She must boil the water. We must taste the soup.

Chaque phrase a une faute. Écris la phrase correcte. She must to add salt. My brother have to wash the pot. He musts stir the soup. She must add salt. My brother has to wash the pot. He must stir the soup.

Lis le dialogue, puis réponds aux questions en anglais. Karniella: Grandma, I want to cook the tchonron soup. Help me, please! Grandma: First, you must wash your hands. Karniella: And then? Grandma: You have to wash the bean leaves and cut the onions. Karniella: Who has to boil the water? Grandma: Your brother has to boil the water. Then we add the leaves and the groundnut powder. Karniella: And the salt? Grandma: You must add a little salt and stir the soup.

quiz.explication: Subject + must + verb: You must wash your hands.

quiz.explication: Must ne prend pas de -s, et le verbe vient tout de suite après : She must cook.

quiz.question: Complete: My mother ___ boil the water.

quiz.question: Avec quels sujets utilise-t-on « has to » ?
quiz.explication: Has to : avec he, she, it. Have to : avec I, you, we, they.

quiz.question: « Must » et « have to » servent à dire…
quiz.explication: Must et have to : pour dire qu'une chose est obligatoire.
